subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

It has a free –OH at C-1

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry
prompt: Which of the following is a fat-soluble vitamin?

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry

subject: Chemistry
prompt: Which carbohydrate is present in the cell wall of plants?
explain: Cellulose (β-1,4 glucose polymer) is the main structural component of plant cell walls.

subject: Chemistry
